title: The Kamino Landing Pad Battle
front_description: It's the power of a Jedi Knight against the wiles of a seasoned bounty hunter, as Obi-Wan and Jango Fett clash atop the Kamino landing platform. With a little help from his resourceful son Boba, the armor-clad Fett manages to keep Kenobi at bay, as both fierce warriors trade blows high above the storm-tossed ocean. Eventually, the Fetts manage to blast off.. .but only after a quick-thinking Obi-Wan plants a tracking device on their ship.
back_description: Actors clash before a blue screen - A computer generated background will be added later.
